sqlquery.from:
( select sts.name, pj.id,pj.name projectname, account.name client ,coalesce(t.taskCount,0) taskCount ,coalesce(notComplatedTaskCount,0) notComplatedTaskCount ,coalesce(tsh.timeSpentByProject,0) timeSpentByProject, coalesce(pj.percent,0) complete , coalesce(man.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(man.lastname) managername ,coalesce(coalesce(coalesce((case sts.code when 'ONGOING' then 1 end), (case false when isSystemReference then 2 end)), (case sts.code when 'PS_NOT_STARTED' then 3 end)),(case sts.code when 'PS_COMPLETED' then 4 end)) sorder ,( case interval '1 day' >= (pj.duedate-now()) when true then to_char((pj.duedate-now()),'DD "d"') else to_char((pj.duedate-now()),'HH24"h" MI"m"') end ) timeleft from "$".project pj left join "$".crmaccount account on pj.clientid = account.id left join "$".myuser man on pj.managerid=man.id left join (select count(t.id) taskCount,projectid ,count(case when r.code not in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED','CANCELLED') then 1 end ) notComplatedTaskCount from "$".task t left join "$".reference r on t.statusid=r.id where t.isIssue is not true and t.deleted is not true group by projectid) t on pj.id=t.projectid left join (select projectID, sum(timespent) timeSpentByProject from "$".timesheet group by projectID) tsh on pj.id=tsh.projectID join "$".reference sts on pj.statusid=sts.id left outer join "$".projectemployee pe on pj.id=pe.projectid left outer join "$".teamemployee te on (pe.employeedepartmentid=te.id ) left outer join "$".myuser mu on (te.employeeid=mu.id) left join "$".location l on mu.locationId=l.id left join "$".clientcontact cc on mu.id=cc.id left join "$".crmaccount ca on pj.clientid=ca.id left join "$".crmcontact cc_cc on cc.crmcontactid=cc_cc.id left join "$".crmAccount cc_ca on cc_cc.crmAccount=cc_ca.id
,(select * from "$".myuser u where u.id=#?user_id?# )u left join "$".location ul on u.locationId=ul.id ,(select min(x)* min(y) xy from (select case r.code in ('ADMIN','DR') when true then 0 else 1 end x , case r.code='ADMIN_LOCATION' when true then 1 else 0 end y from "$".myuser_role ur join "$".role r on ur.roles_id=r.id where ur.users_id=#?user_id?#) a) roles ,(select count(rp.rolecode) x from permission p join "$".rolepermission rp on p.code=rp.permissioncode join "$".reference r on rp.priviledgeid=r.id join "$".role rl on rp.rolecode=rl.code join "$".myuser_role ur on r.id=ur.roles_id where rp.permissioncode='PM_SEE_ALL_PROJECTS' and r.code='ALLOW') see_all , (select max(x) has from (select case r.code in ('ADMIN') when true then 1 else 0 end x from "$".myuser_role ur join "$".role r on ur.roles_id=r.id where ur.users_id=#?user_id?#) a) isAdmin where pe.isdeleted is not true and pj.isdeleted is not true and pj.parnetId is null and ( (roles.xy=1 and see_all.x=0 and l.id=ul.id)/*1*/ or (roles.xy !=1 or see_all.x !=0 ) and ( (cc.id is not null and ca.id=cc_ca.id)/*2*/ or (cc.id is null and mu.id=#?user_id?#)/*3*/ ) or isAdmin.has =1 ) and ( #?replacement?# )
order by sorder asc, timeSpentByProject desc
)t

replacement.name: See All Projects
replacement.value: (roles.xy !=1 or see_all.x !=0 ) and ( (cc.id is not null and ca.id=cc_ca.id)
